title: Paged listing
description: Print the items in pages of size items each. Every page starts with the header line `-- page P of Q --` (P counts from 1, Q is the total number of pages) followed by that page's items, one per line, exactly as given; the last page may hold fewer items. An empty list prints only the line `(no items)` and counts as 0 pages. If size is less than 1, return the error `page size must be at least 1` and print nothing at all (this check comes first, even for an empty list). Otherwise return the number of pages as a success value.

visible_examples.stdout:
-- page 1 of 2 --
a
b
-- page 2 of 2 --
c

args: page size must be at least 1

notes: Level 2. Ceiling division on positive numbers only (items count >= 1, size >= 1); the total Q must be known before the first header is printed; the bad-size error wins over the empty list; size larger than the list gives one page; empty items keep their (blank) line; page numbers go past 9. Largest size 9e15.
